best_for: Windows users who just deleted a file, emptied the Recycle Bin or formatted a memory card, and want a free first try at getting it back.

points.title: Free recovers the same files
points.text: The free edition includes the full file recovery. Pro adds virtual hard drive support, automatic updates and priority support for USD 24.95. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Cards, sticks and broken drives
points.text: It looks for deleted photos, music, documents, video and email on hard drives, memory cards, USB sticks and external drives, including damaged or freshly formatted ones. A deep scan digs further when the quick scan finds nothing.

points.title: It can erase, too
points.text: A secure overwrite option wipes files you want gone for good, so they can't be recovered by Recuva or similar tools.

points.title: Expect a CCleaner upsell
points.text: Recuva now comes from Gen Digital under the CCleaner brand, and its page also pushes CCleaner Professional Plus, a bundle for up to 3 PCs.

points.title: Windows only, slow release pace
points.text: There is no Mac or Linux version. The Windows listing keeps 3 versions, up to 1.55.0.133, with x86 and x64 installers for all users that need Windows 10 or later.
